$comment: Every game shipped by the All Games DEV catalog must have one explicit Depth capability state.
This file is an audit surface, not a source of runtime authorization. Only catalog_ready entries
with a real DepthProfile and CameraBinding may ever report recording_ready=true, and only when all
runtime gates such as an approved generation-bound performance certificate also pass. local_trial means that
raw Depth can be collected under a game-specific non-production contract but cannot enter the
formal StartRun/Ready/delivery path. not_assessed is intentionally fail-closed.
rendererEvidence is a separate renderer-backend audit surface. graphicsApis lists only APIs
named by the cited repository evidence; rendererMode describes whether that evidence names one,
multiple, or no API. Product survey evidence is never exact-build runtime evidence.
Every exact-build renderer tier carries exactBuildIdentity. Its AppID and executable bytes must
cross-check against the rights ledger plus final classification or exact catalog/target evidence;
buildId is null unless a machine-readable target or structured local-trial record binds it.
finalLedgerAudit separates the full observed-build classification ledger from its shipped-roster
mapping. final_for_observed_build=true is hard-terminal authority only when an independent repository
record exists and the catalog identity is consistent; product survey/taxonomy or identity conflict
keeps the mapped capability provisional and disabled.
